label: Complete Goth Set
description: Complete goth looks reimagined as full cinematic portraits — outfit, accessories, hair, makeup, pose, and moody film lighting woven into one high-detail scene. Pick a look and refine extras (background, lighting, accessories) in details.
details_tooltip: Extras to refine: backdrop, lighting mood, accessories, expression. Example: moonlit graveyard mist, candlelit glow, lace choker, silver chains
items: A striking young woman in classic trad-goth style, captured in a moody studio portrait. She wears a black velvet dress with delicate lace trim, fishnet tights, and black combat boots — the plush velvet absorbing the light while the lace and fishnet catch subtle highlights. A silver chain choker completes the dark look. Hair is long, straight, and jet black. Makeup is heavy and dramatic — pale porcelain foundation, deep matte burgundy lips, and heavy black winged eyeliner. Pose is cool and confident, one hand resting at her collarbone, chin lifted with a piercing gaze. Shot on 35mm film with dramatic low-key lighting, a soft key light on the face, and a glowing rim light against a deep charcoal backdrop. Fine film grain and gentle halation add gothic atmosphere. Three-quarter shot, shallow depth of field, high-fashion composition. Photorealistic, highly detailed velvet texture and fishnet weave, authentic trad-goth glamour, no modern digital sharpness.

A dreamy young woman in romantic goth style, captured in a softly lit, candlelit studio portrait. She wears a dark Victorian lace blouse over a black corset, a floor-length layered tulle skirt, and lace gloves — the delicate lace and tulle catching warm candlelight in layered shadows. Dark rose hair accessories and a black lace parasol complete the romantic look. Hair is long and softly waved in deep raven tones. Makeup is soft and dramatic — gentle smokey eyes, wine-red lips, and pale luminous skin. Pose is graceful and wistful, holding the parasol at her shoulder, looking softly to the side. Shot on 35mm film with warm low-key candlelight, gentle rim light, and a blurred dark Victorian backdrop. Fine film grain and gentle halation add old-world romance. Three-quarter shot, shallow depth of field, high-fashion composition. Photorealistic, highly detailed lace weave and corset boning, authentic romantic-goth glamour, no modern digital sharpness.
